name: Scout
description: Sees the horde before the horde sees you.
long_description: The crew that knows what's over the ridge outlives the crew that guesses. Scouts travel light, sleep cold and read the Wasteland like a departures board. Mastery opens four very different roads: Sharpshooter, Rancher, Pathfinder - and a darker one for those who've stopped flinching at the dead.
